lines: Saketchandrasingh Pratapsingh Dhandoriya, role unknown, is selling 3,736,000 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹123.29 crore are scheduled on or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document; not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
Retained shares are an estimate of ₹155.04 crore at the offer price, so more value remains with them after this sale.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition is not confirmed from the documents.
